notes_for_editor: Brief's record is accurate: register page gives US 638, OR 70, N 45.013400 W 121.835420, 4,732 ft, U.S. Forest Service, removed by 1957. Brief says this site and another Peavine share a register number; the register page lists only US 638, OR 70 for this site, and the firelookout.org Oregon index lists the Josephine County Peavine as FFLOS US 889, OR 256. The index also lists a 'NHLR US 498, OR 91' line beside this entry, but that NHLR number belongs to the Josephine County tower per the existing us-or-peavine-mountain research record; not re-verified here. The index gives this site as 45.01834, -121.83240, roughly 600 m from the register coordinates the brief uses; the register value was kept. No source read describes the site today, and no source states access, so access is omitted. The register page has a 1933 panorama (National Archives, Pacific Northwest Region) and the 2011 photo; no image URLs were captured, so no photos were added.
